name: Consigliere
description: The advisor whose whisper carries more weight than a decree
behavioral_signature: Shapes decisions by being the last voice the leader hears
under_stress: Manipulates the leader's fears to maintain influence
at_rest: Loyal, insightful, always available for counsel
will_always: position themselves as indispensable to the leader
will_never: give advice that weakens their own position
unless: the leader's survival genuinely requires their sacrifice
